welcome.title: Welcome to Trial by Fire
welcome.subtitle: Your Fantasy Survivor experience
welcome.body: Draft castaways, earn points, make predictions, and compete with friends across the entire season.

draft.title: Draft Your Survivor
draft.subtitle: Your main castaway
draft.body: Each player in your league drafts one castaway. Only you earn points for everything they do. No one else can pick your player.
draft.customizable: Your league can customize point values for challenges, idols, advantages, and more. Commissioners can also create custom events that they score and track manually.

streak.title: Build Your Streak
streak.subtitle: Bonus points that grow each episode
streak.body: Every episode your survivor stays in the game, you earn escalating bonus points: 1, then 2, then 3, and so on. The longer they last, the more you earn.
streak.customizable: Your league can set a streak cap (e.g. max 5 pts/episode), leave it unlimited, or disable streaks entirely.

predictions.title: Make Predictions
predictions.subtitle: Call the shots each episode
predictions.body: Before each episode, predict what will happen. Correct predictions earn you bonus points on top of your survivor's score.
predictions.customizable: Your league chooses which events can be predicted and when. Predict the winner at the draft, merge, or finale. Predict tribe challenge winners pre-merge, individual winners post-merge. Commissioners can also create custom predictions.

livePredictions.title: Live Predictions
livePredictions.subtitle: Play along while watching
livePredictions.body: While episodes are airing, join live and predict what happens in real time. No points on the line, just bragging rights. Track your accuracy and build a streak across the season.

bets.title: Place Your Bets
bets.subtitle: Wager points on your predictions
bets.body: Once betting opens, wager points you've earned throughout the season on predictions. If you're right, you gain those points on top of the base score. If you miss, you lose the wager.
bets.customizable: Your league controls when betting activates (e.g. at the merge or a custom episode), the max points per bet, how many bets per week, and which prediction events are bettable. Betting can also be disabled entirely.

secondary.title: Pick a Secondary
secondary.subtitle: A second castaway for bonus points
secondary.body: Each episode, choose a secondary player. Multiple people can pick the same one. Unlike your main survivor, your secondary doesn't earn streak points. You can still pick one even if your main has been eliminated.
secondary.customizable: Your league controls the points multiplier (50% or full), the lockout period before re-picking the same player (or never repeat), whether you can pick your own survivor, and whether picks are visible to others before the episode airs.

shotInTheDark.title: Shot in the Dark
shotInTheDark.subtitle: A last-ditch play to save your streak
shotInTheDark.body: Think your survivor is going home? Play your Shot in the Dark before the episode airs. If they do get voted out, you keep your streak bonus when you pick a new player. You only get one per league, use it wisely.
shotInTheDark.customizable: Your league can enable or disable Shot in the Dark. It requires survival streaks to be active.

switchPick.title: Switch Your Pick
switchPick.subtitle: Swap before it's too late
switchPick.body: You can change your main survivor at any time before they're eliminated. But be careful: once you drop them, someone else can scoop them up.
switchPick.customizable: Your league controls whether voluntary switches preserve your streak or reset it to zero.

ready.title: Survivors Ready...
ready.subtitle: Time to outwatch, outpredict, outscore
ready.body: Join a league, draft your survivor, and start competing. May the best fantasy player win.
